description: Aseprite v1.2.15 English UI — self-drawn Allegro UI, no UIA. Adapter drives it via screenshot OCR of the top menu strip and keyboard hotkeys. Drawing/canvas actions are intentionally not exposed here yet.

actions.description: Press an Aseprite hotkey combination (B pencil, N spray, E eraser, G paint bucket, 1..9 zoom, Ctrl+Z undo, etc.). No screenshot verification; caller decides how to observe result.

Capture the top menu strip, OCR it, then click the labeled entry. Supported names: File, Edit, Sprite, Layer, Frame, Select, Tags, View, Help. Returns the recognized OCR score and clicked window-relative point.
